ZZ AUDIT SOURCE MANUSCRIPT (synthetic test content, safe to delete)
Widget Calibration Program: Quarterly Status
The Widget Calibration Program covers 42 widgets across three sites: North Depot (18 widgets), River Annex (15 widgets), and Hilltop Lab (9 widgets). Each widget's calibration counter must be reset every 30 days by the Widget Custodian.
In the third quarter, 39 of 42 widgets were reset on schedule, a compliance rate of 92.9 percent. The three late resets were all at River Annex and were caused by a two-week vacancy in the Widget Custodian position. The vacancy was filled on 14 September.
"We lost two weeks, and it showed up immediately in the numbers," said Dana Okafor, the program manager. "The process itself is sound."
The reset procedure takes about four minutes per widget. After a reset, the status light turns amber for 90 seconds. Staff reported that the amber light is sometimes mistaken for a fault indication, and two unnecessary service tickets were opened in August for that reason.
Recommendations under consideration: 1. Name an alternate Widget Custodian at each site so that a vacancy does not interrupt resets. 2. Add a label beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after a reset is normal. 3. Review whether the 30-day interval could be extended to 45 days; this has not been evaluated and no data yet supports it.
The next quarterly review is scheduled for January.

## Program Overview and Scope

The Widget Calibration Program covers 42 widgets across North Depot (18), River Annex (15), Hilltop Lab (9) [D1]. Each widget's calibration counter must be reset every 30 days by the Widget Custodian [D1].

## Q3 Reset Performance and Vacancy

- 39 of 42 widgets reset on schedule, compliance rate 92.9 percent [D1]
- Three late resets all at River Annex caused by a two-week vacancy in Widget Custodian position [D1]
- Vacancy filled on 14 September [D1]
- "We lost two weeks, and it showed up immediately in numbers," said Dana Okafor, the program manager [D1]

## Reset Procedure and Observations

- [S1] Reset procedure: open Widget Console, select Maintenance, choose Calibration, Reset Counter; enter confirmation phrase BLUE HERON 4417; counter returns to zero, status light amber for 90 seconds
- [D1] In the third quarter, 39 of 42 widgets were reset on schedule, a compliance rate of 92.9 percent. The three late resets were all at River Annex and were caused by a two-week vacancy in the Widget Custodian position. The vacancy was filled on 14 September.
- [D1] "We lost two weeks, and it showed up immediately in the numbers," said Dana Okafor, the program manager. "The process itself is sound."

## Recommendations Under Consideration

- Name an alternate Widget Custodian at each site
- Add a label beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after reset is normal
- Review whether the 30-day interval could be extended to 45 days

Source: [D1]

## Widget Calibration Program — Quarterly Status

Each site (North Depot, River Annex, Hilltop Lab) needs an alternate Widget Custodian named so that a vacancy does not interrupt resets. A label should be added beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after reset is normal. The 30-day reset interval should be reviewed for extension to 45 days; this has not been evaluated and no data yet supports it [D1]. Next quarterly review scheduled for January [D1].

## Program Overview and Scope

The Widget Calibration Program covers 42 widgets across North Depot (18), River Annex (15), Hilltop Lab (9) [D1]. Each widget's calibration counter must be reset every 30 days by the Widget Custodian [D1].

## Q3 Reset Performance and Vacancy

- 39 of 42 widgets reset on schedule, compliance rate 92.9 percent [D1]
- Three late resets all at River Annex caused by a two-week vacancy in Widget Custodian position [D1]
- Vacancy filled on 14 September [D1]
- "We lost two weeks, and it showed up immediately in the numbers," said Dana Okafor, the program manager [D1]

## Reset Procedure and Observations

- Reset procedure: open the Widget Console, select Maintenance, choose Calibration, then Reset Counter; enter the confirmation phrase BLUE HERON 4417; the counter returns to zero and the status light turns amber for 90 seconds [S1].
- [D1] "The process itself is sound," Dana Okafor, the program manager, added.

## Recommendations Under Consideration

- Name an alternate Widget Custodian at each site
- Add a label beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after reset is normal
- Review whether the 30-day interval could be extended to 45 days

Source: [D1]

## Widget Calibration Program — Quarterly Status

Recommendations under consideration: name an alternate Widget Custodian at each site so that a vacancy does not interrupt resets; add a label beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after reset is normal; review whether the 30-day interval could be extended to 45 days, which has not been evaluated and no data yet supports it [D1]. Next quarterly review scheduled for January [D1].
